scripts.package: npm run build && npm run zip
scripts.zip: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path lambda.zip) { Remove-Item lambda.zip }; Compress-Archive -Path dist/*,node_modules -DestinationPath lambda.zip"
scripts.deploy: aws lambda update-function-code --function-name StudentEncyclopedia --zip-file fileb://lambda.zip --region eu-central-1 --profile mwsoo3a
